title: Auditing Empirical Comparisons in Quantum Software
abstract: arXiv:2607.00516v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Empirical quantum-software papers often claim that one compiler produces smaller circuits, one optimizer is more reliable, or one ansatz achieves better solution quality. Such comparisons depend on benchmark scope, circuit construction, compilation, sampling, backends, noise models, optimizer choices, and resource budgets. Existing testing, benchmarking, and reproducibility methods help assess programs and experiments but do not directly audit whether the reported comparison is supported by the evidence available in the paper and artifact. We present CLAIMSTAB-QC, a source-bounded framework that records baselines, metric, relation, and admissible evidence; locks the audit design before outcomes are computed; and reports a scoped relation outcome or an explicit evidence boundary. translated_title: 量子软件实证比较的审计
translated_abstract: 量子软件实证论文常常声称某个编译器能生成更小的电路、某个优化器更可靠、或某个拟设能获得更好的解质量。这类比较依赖于基准测试范围、电路构建、编译、采样、后端、噪声模型、优化器选择和资源预算等因素。现有的测试、基准测试和可复现性方法有助于评估程序和实验，但并不能直接审计所报告的比较结论是否得到了论文与工件中可用证据的支持。我们提出了 CLAIMSTAB-QC，这是一个以来源为边界的框架，它记录基线、度量指标、关系类型和可采纳的证据；在计算结果之前锁定审计设计；并给出有明确范围的关系性结论或明确的证据边界。在锁定的审计范围内，严格的标量方向性比较会被分类为“维持”、“未决”或“未保留”。我们考察了455条比较性声明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了CLAIMSTAB-QC审计框架，通过在计算结果前锁定审计设计、限定证据来源边界，将量子软件论文中的455条实证比较声明分类为“维持”、“未决”或“未保留”，从而检验比较结论是否有证据支撑。
en_tdlr: CLAIMSTAB-QC is a source-bounded audit framework that locks the audit design before outcomes are computed and classifies 455 comparative claims in quantum software papers as Sustained, Unresolved, or Not preserved, auditing whether reported comparisons are supported by available evidence.
